verdict.rationale: Docusaurus is a docs framework, so gating content behind authentication is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows only that it builds static HTML for static hosts and lets developers swizzle React components. Neither is a documented password, JWT, or SSO gating capability: hosting is a host-platform matter and swizzling is a developer building block.

support.subject: As a DevRel lead, I gate some or all docs behind authentication — password, JWT, or SSO — for customers-only content
